findings.evidence: Frobenius.lean:162 `t.geckFrobenius ht p k A (t.geckRootSubgroupPoints ht i A u) = ...`; TwistedFrobenius.lean:326-333 and GraphAutomorphism.lean:437-443 use the mk form; the identical `hroot` block appears at TwistedFrobenius.lean:201-207 and 334-340.
findings.fix: Restate both new lemmas on `t.geckRootSubgroupPoints ht i A u` (naming them `..._pow_geckRootSubgroupPoints`), matching `geckFrobenius_geckRootSubgroupPoints`; if the mk shape is still wanted, expose the bridge once as a public `DynkinType.geckPoints_mk_geckRootSubgroupMatrix` in GroupScheme.lean beside `geckPoints_mk_geckTorusMatrix` instead of duplicating it in proofs.
findings.issue: `geckTwistedFrobenius_pow_geckRootSubgroupMatrix` (and `geckGraphAutPoints_pow_geckRootSubgroupMatrix`, GraphAutomorphism.lean:435) state both sides as `⟨t.geckRootSubgroupMatrix ht i _, _⟩` instead of the canonical `t.geckRootSubgroupPoints ht i A u` that `geckFrobenius_geckRootSubgroupPoints` (Frobenius.lean:160) uses. A consumer holding `geckRootSubgroupPoints` cannot apply them without a shape change, and the `@[simp]` annotations will not fire on the canonical term; each proof also re-inlines the same bridge `have hroot` (TwistedFrobenius.lean:201-207 and again 334-340).

findings.evidence: GeckCarrier.lean:160 `geckWeightTorus_def` and :236 `geckFrobenius_def` exist; no `geckRootSubgroup_def`. OrdinarySteinberg.lean:196, 342, 399 all insert `simp only [ValidLieTypeIndex.geckRootSubgroup_eq_mk]` before applying the lower-layer lemma.
findings.fix: Add `geckRootSubgroup_def` beside `geckWeightTorus_def` and `geckFrobenius_def`, restate the lower-layer lemmas in `geckRootSubgroupPoints` form (previous finding), and drop `geckRootSubgroup_eq_mk`.
findings.issue: `geckRootSubgroup_eq_mk` is new public surface added only to compensate for the mk-shaped lower-layer statements: the OrdinarySteinberg proofs must `simp only [ValidLieTypeIndex.geckRootSubgroup_eq_mk]` to reach them, and the previously working proof of `geckGraphAut_geckRootSubgroup` was rewritten onto that route. The unfolding lemma the file actually lacks is the one parallel to its siblings, `geckRootSubgroup_def : d.geckRootSubgroup = d.dynkinType.geckRootSubgroupPoints d.dynkinType_valid i d.Closure`.

findings.evidence: Grep for `pow.*WeightTorus` under the Geck files returns no such lemma; GraphAutomorphism.lean:75-80 itself calls the root-subgroup and torus equations "the two pinning equations on points" and the PR's own doc line adds only "the first of those equations iterated".
findings.fix: Add the five torus counterparts: `γ ^ m (t(s)) = t(fun k => s ((σ ^ m)⁻¹ k))`, `Frob ^ m (t(s)) = t(s ^ q ^ m)`, `F ^ m (t(s)) = t(fun k => s ((σ ^ m)⁻¹ k) ^ q ^ m)`, at both layers, proved by the same separation/induction as the root-subgroup versions.
findings.issue: Only one of the two halves of the pinned data is iterated. Every file touched pairs a root-subgroup equation with a weight-torus equation at `m = 1`, but the PR adds power forms for the root subgroups alone: no `geckSteinberg_pow_geckWeightTorus` (:302 has the `m = 1` form), no `geckGraphAut_pow_geckWeightTorus` (:205), no `ValidLieTypeIndex.geckFrobenius_pow_geckWeightTorus` (GeckCarrier.lean:268), no `geckTwistedFrobenius_pow_geckWeightTorusPoints` (TwistedFrobenius.lean:214), no `geckGraphAutPoints_pow_geckWeightTorusPoints` (GraphAutomorphism.lean:497). A consumer of `F ^ e` on torus points — the natural power form of the existing `geckWeightTorus_mem_fixedSubgroup_geckSteinberg` — has no lemma and must unfold.

summary: The new iterated pinning lemmas are stated on the raw subtype-mk shape rather than on the canonical `geckRootSubgroupPoints`, which forces a compensating bridge lemma at the index layer and makes the `@[simp]` annotations unable to fire on canonical terms; and only the root-subgroup half of the pinning data is iterated, leaving the weight-torus half without any power form in four files that develop both sides everywhere else.
